battle.name: 421-422年羅馬-薩珊戰爭
battle.theater: 上美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞戰線
battle.brief: 421年，薩珊王巴赫拉姆五世迫害基督徒、扣留羅馬商人財產，狄奧多西二世遂撕毀和約，命阿蘭裔主帥阿爾達布爾東征：奇襲阿爾扎內尼、於美索不達米亞擊敗納爾塞斯、再圍尼西比斯。卡面埃及月牙劍是外彎單刃劍的祖型，與羅馬 falcata、波斯短刀同出一脈。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 421至422年的羅馬—薩珊戰爭，交戰的兩方是東羅馬帝國與薩珊波斯，但真正決定戰線形態的還有第三、第四股力量。羅馬方面：皇帝狄奧多西二世坐鎮君士坦丁堡，東線全軍交由阿爾達布爾（Ardabur）指揮，此人出身伊朗化的阿蘭人部族；其下有將領阿納托利奧斯（Anatolius）被派往波斯亞美尼亞，策動當地的不平者。兵力靠全帝國抽調：色雷斯的羅馬主力被調往東方，狄奧多西二世則准許潘諾尼亞的東哥特人定居色雷斯，替帝國守住多瑙河下游、抵擋匈人。薩珊方面：國王巴赫拉姆五世（Bahram V）接位未久，軍隊以沙赫的親兵、亞美尼亞與波斯亞美尼亞的駐防軍、弓箭手與重裝騎兵為骨幹；前線統帥是久經沙場的將軍納爾塞斯（Narses），他吃了一次敗仗後便改走迂迴與圍城。外盟方面，拉赫姆王朝的阿拉伯王公阿爾曼杜拉魯斯（Alamundurus）與薩珊結盟，在南方牽制羅馬；匈人王魯加（Ruga）則大軍壓境，攻入達西亞與色雷斯教區，直逼君士坦丁堡，使東線無法長期僵持。羅馬的多線抽調與薩珊的外交結盟，構成本役的兩副骨架。
countriesEn: The Roman-Sasanian war of 421-422 was fought between the Eastern Roman Empire and Sasanian Persia, but two further powers actually shaped the form of the front. On the Roman side, Emperor Theodosius II sat at Constantinople and entrusted the entire eastern command to Ardabur, who came from the Iranianised Alan tribe and was appointed supreme commander; under him the general Anatolius was sent to Persarmenia to stir the discontented there. The troops were raised by drawing on the whole empire: the Roman field forces of Thrace were transferred to the East, and to fill the gap Theodosius II permitted the Pannonian Ostrogoths to settle in Thrace, so that a new ally would hold the lower Danube and keep the Huns off the empire. On the Sasanian side, King Bahram V, newly come to the throne, fielded an army whose backbone was the shah's household troops, the garrisons of Armenia and Persarmenia, archers and heavily armoured cavalry; the commander in the field was the veteran general Narses, who after one defeat changed to a war of manoeuvre and sieges. Among the allies, the Arab prince of the Lakhmid house, Alamundurus, allied with the Sasanians and pinned the Romans in the south; the Hunnic king Ruga, meanwhile, drove his host into the dioceses of Dacia and Thracia and came within reach of Constantinople, so that the eastern war could not be prolonged indefinitely. Roman dispersion across several fronts and Sasanian reliance on foreign alliances were the two frameworks of the campaign.
people: 人物以狄奧多西二世與巴赫拉姆五世為兩端，中間是兩軍的將領與一批改變局面的教會人物。狄奧多西二世是東羅馬皇帝，這一戰時他正值壯年，宗教上日益虔誠，姐姐普爾刻里婭（Pulcheria）在宮廷的影響力與日俱增，是推動他採取強硬立場的一股力量。巴赫拉姆五世於420年父王耶茲德格一世遇弒後即位，延續了父王對基督徒的高壓。阿爾達布爾是全軍主帥，出身阿蘭人卻受羅馬重用，顯示帝國在東方高度倚重外族將領；他的部將阿納托利奧斯被派往波斯亞美尼亞做說客。薩珊方面的納爾塞斯是前線主將，兵敗之後仍握兵權，改以圍城與外交周旋。宗教人物在這場戰爭裡並非背景板：君士坦丁堡主教阿提庫斯（Atticus）接納流亡的基督徒並把消息稟報皇帝；被薩珊殺害的耶茲德格一世近臣雅各·因特西庫斯（James Intercisus）先改宗瑣羅亞斯德教、又改回基督教，成為迫害最著名的死者；狄奧多西奧波利斯主教歐諾米奧斯（Eunomius）以一台以使徒多馬命名的投石機擊斃薩珊軍中一名小王，勸退圍城者；安米達主教阿卡基奧斯（Acacius）把教會的金銀祭器熔化，換回七千名淪入奴隸市場的波斯戰俘並全部釋放。匈人王魯加與阿拉伯王公穆恩齊爾一世分據南北，牽制兩方。
peopleEn: The figures at the two ends of this war are Theodosius II and Bahram V, and between them stand the generals of the two armies and a number of churchmen whose decisions changed the course of events. Theodosius II, emperor of the Eastern Romans, was in the prime of his life and had become increasingly devout; the influence of his sister Pulcheria at the court grew steadily and was a force pushing him toward a hard line. Bahram V came to the throne in 420 after the murder of his father Yazdegerd I and carried on the persecution of Christians begun under his father. Ardabur was the commander in chief, an Alan by birth yet employed by Rome, which shows how heavily the empire in the east relied on federate commanders; his subordinate Anatolius was sent to Persarmenia as an emissary. On the Sasanian side Narses was the field commander; even after his defeat he kept his command and turned to siege warfare and diplomacy. The clergy were not background figures in this war: Atticus, bishop of Constantinople, received the exiled Christians and reported the matter to the emperor; James Intercisus, a councillor of Yazdegerd I who had converted to Zoroastrianism and then back to Christianity, was killed in the persecution and became the best known of the dead; Eunomius, bishop of Theodosiopolis, used a stone-thrower named after the apostle Thomas to kill a lesser king of the Sasanian army and so persuaded the besiegers to lift the siege; and Acacius, bishop of Amida, melted down the gold and silver plate of his church to ransom seven thousand Persian captives who had ended up in the slave market and set them all free. The Hunnic king Ruga and the Arab prince Mundhir I sat at the northern and southern edges of the stage, each pinning down one of the two sides.
kits: 卡面是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）：青銅時代的埃及外彎單刃劍，刃口向內彎，砍進去不必拔出，比直劍更早登上戰場。要說清它在421年這場戰爭裡的位置，只能老實講明：它不在戰場上，它是譜系上的祖先。真正握在兩軍手上的，是這條外彎單刃支系的下游。羅馬方面近戰用短劍（gladius）與長劍（spatha），將官與侍衛另配窄長的佩劍（parazonium）；晚期羅馬軍中仍可見明顯帶鉤的彎刃單邊劍 falcata，其形制與埃及月牙劍同出一脈，學界也有把它與埃及 kopis 相連的看法。薩珊方面則是短刀式的 kard 與直脊長劍，並輔以雙面直刃劍。防具上，羅馬步兵用弧面大盾（scutum）與橢圓小盾（parma），穿環甲（lorica segmentata）、鱗甲（lorica squamata）或鎖子甲（lorica plumata），頭上是脊飾盔；薩珊步兵以大盾與弓為主，鎧甲多見魚鱗式與札甲式，騎兵有金屬鱗片拼接的甲衣與長矛。遠程是薩珊人的複合弓，對面是羅馬的弩炮（ballista）、車弩（carroballista）與扭力投石機（onager）；圍城則有攻城的 helepolis——狄奧多西奧波利斯之圍的羅馬教會文獻正是用這個詞形容薩珊人的攻城機具。運輸與補給靠底格里斯河與幼發拉底河的水運，以及橫穿美索不達米亞的羅馬軍用道路。
kitsEn: The card shows the Egyptian khopesh, the bronze-age sickle sword with an inward-curving edge that could be left in a wound and needed no pulling back, and which reached the battlefield before the straight sword did. Its place in the campaign of 421 has to be stated honestly: it was not on the field, it is an ancestor in a genealogy. What the two armies actually held were the downstream forms of that same outward-curving single-edged line. The Romans fought with the gladius and the spatha, and officers and guards carried the narrow long parazonium; in the late Roman army one can still meet the plainly hooked falcata, a single-edged blade of the same family, and scholars have sometimes connected it with the Egyptian kopis. The Sasanians used the short dagger-like kard and straight-backed long swords, with the straight double-edged sword as well. For protection, Roman infantry carried the curved oval scutum and the small round parma, and wore the lorica segmentata, the scale armour lorica squamata or the mail lorica plumata, with ridge helmets on their heads; Sasanian infantry fought mainly with large shields and the bow, in scale and lamellar armour, while their cavalry had lamellar cuirasses assembled from metal plates and long lances. At range there were the Sasanian composite bow on one side and the Roman ballista, carroballista and the torsion onager on the other; for siege work there was the helepolis, and it is precisely that word that the Roman ecclesiastical source uses of the Sasanian siege machines at Theodosiopolis. Movement and supply rode on the waterways of the Tigris and Euphrates and on the Roman military roads crossing Mesopotamia.
tactics: 阿爾達布爾的戰法是分路齊進、不求速決，計畫分三段。先派阿納托利奧斯往波斯亞美尼亞，聯絡當地反對薩珊的力量，把戰線點燃；主力由阿爾達布爾自率，踏入薩珊領土，在亞美尼亞高原上的阿爾扎內尼一帶縱火破壞村鎮與糧秣；然後在納爾塞斯兵敗退入美索不達米亞、打算趁該區防務空虛反擊之際，及時趕到幼發拉底河與底格里斯河之間的走廊攔截，不讓他打到羅馬的空虛省份。等增援抵達，他把大軍壓上尼西比斯，圍困這座羅馬在上美索不達米亞東側的堡壘，把薩珊的攻勢釘在城牆之外。薩珊的應對同樣是三段式：先在野戰中用納爾塞斯的進攻試探，發現不敵便立刻脫離、不再接受會戰，改以圍城與正面施壓；同時拉攏南方的拉赫姆阿拉伯人，把羅馬的注意力分到兩河下游；再在北方倚靠匈人魯加的進攻牽制君士坦丁堡，逼得狄奧多西二世在422年召回阿爾達布爾。特別值得注意的是，圍困狄奧多西奧波利斯時羅馬沒有出兵解圍，說明這場戰爭的戰略優先次序很清楚：主戰場在東線，北方與西方不能同時開火。
tacticsEn: Ardabur's method was to strike on several axes at once and not to seek a quick decision, and the plan had three stages. First Anatolius was sent to Persarmenia to make contact with the forces hostile to the Sasanians and to set the front alight; the main body under Ardabur then entered Sasanian territory and laid waste to the villages and stores of Arzanene in the Armenian highlands; and when Narses, beaten in the field, fell back into Mesopotamia with the intention of striking at the Roman province whose defence had been left open, Ardabur moved up in time to intercept him in the corridor between the Tigris and the Euphrates and let him nowhere near the empty province. When the reinforcements arrived he pressed the siege of Nisibis, the Roman fortress on the eastern side of Upper Mesopotamia, pinning the Sasanian offensive against the walls. The Sasanian answer had three parts in turn: a trial of strength in open battle with the advance under Narses, and once that failed an immediate refusal of any further pitched engagement, the campaign turning on sieges and on frontal pressure; then the drawing in of the Lakhmid Arabs in the south, to divide the Roman attention towards the lower two rivers; and finally reliance on the Hunnic advance under Ruga in the north, which menaced Constantinople and forced Theodosius II to recall Ardabur in 422. It is worth noting that no Roman army came to relieve Theodosiopolis, which shows the order of priorities clearly: the main theatre lay in the east, and the empire could not fight in the north and the west at the same time.
data: 可引用的數字有限，這本身就是這場戰爭的特點。時間：戰爭橫跨421與422兩個作戰年度，開戰的確切月份史料未載，一般只能按春季至秋季的作戰季理解；狄奧多西奧波利斯之圍持續三十日。兵員：教會史家索克拉蒂斯只說薩珊圍城軍為數千人，並攜帶攻城機具 helepolis；雙方野戰部隊的具體數目沒有可靠記載，不必硬湊。戰俘：安米達主教阿卡基奧斯把教會的金銀祭器熔化，換回七千名淪入奴隸市場的波斯戰俘，全部釋放歸國。地理：羅馬皇帝所在的君士坦丁堡至前線尼西比斯約一千三百公里，換言之調兵、傳令與補給線都極長；尼西比斯（今土耳其東南部底格里斯河畔）沿河上行至安米達約三百公里；從美索不達米亞到波斯亞美尼亞約六百公里，這是阿爾達布爾補給線最遠處。北方戰線上，魯加的匈人軍團攻入達西亞與色雷斯教區並威脅首都，羅馬不得不重新計算抽調到東方的色雷斯兵力。制度面：和約由軍務總監赫利奧（Helio）代表羅馬談成，條款只有恢復戰前狀態、互不接受對方逃兵、互保宗教自由三項，沒有割地條款，也沒有戰俘贖金條款。
dataEn: The quotable figures are few, and that in itself is a feature of this war. Time: the war ran across the two campaigning years 421 and 422; the exact month of the outbreak is not recorded and can only be understood as falling in the spring-to-autumn campaigning season; the siege of Theodosiopolis lasted thirty days. Men: the church historian Socrates speaks only of thousands of men in the Sasanian besieging force, together with the siege engine called a helepolis; there is no reliable figure for the size of either field army, and no good reason to invent one. Captives: Acacius, bishop of Amida, melted down the gold and silver plate of his church and with the proceeds bought back seven thousand Persian captives who had ended up in the slave market, sending them home free. Geography: Constantinople, where the Roman emperor sat, was about thirteen hundred kilometres from Nisibis on the front, so that the lines of movement, of orders and of supply were all extremely long; travelling up the Tigris from Nisibis to Amida is about three hundred kilometres; and from Mesopotamia to Persarmenia is roughly six hundred kilometres, which was the far end of Ardabur's supply line. On the northern front the Hunnic host of Ruga drove into the dioceses of Dacia and Thracia and threatened the capital, and the Romans had to recalculate the Thrace troops they had sent east. Institutional: the treaty was negotiated for Rome by the magister officiorum Helio, and its terms were only a return to the situation before the war, mutual refusal of the other's defectors, and mutual guarantee of religious liberty; there was no cession of territory and no ransom clause for prisoners.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最內層是宗教，而且因果是雙向的：耶茲德格一世在位時，部分基督徒攻擊境內的瑣羅亞斯德教神廟，薩珊朝廷便以迫害基督徒作為報復；耶茲德格一世遇弒後，繼位的巴赫拉姆五世把這場迫害延續下去，連改宗又改回的宮廷近臣雅各·因特西庫斯都死於其下。基督徒大批逃入羅馬境內，君士坦丁堡主教阿提庫斯收留並稟報皇帝，狄奧多西二世在姐姐普爾刻里婭的影響下，越來越以基督徒的庇護者自居。第二層是經濟與司法摩擦：薩珊方面僱用了羅馬的金礦工而拒不遣返，又扣押羅馬商人的產業；波斯使節到君士坦丁堡要求交還這些逃亡者，等於在皇帝面前否認羅馬的庇護權。第三層是王位繼承與邊界：420年耶茲德格一世死於非命，巴赫拉姆五世在宮廷鬥爭中上位，薩珊王權的重心一時向東南的波斯與亞美尼亞傾斜；亞美尼亞與波斯亞美尼亞的局勢因此不穩，羅馬與薩珊都想趁勢插手。第四層是帝國整體局勢：西羅馬在410年遭劫後元氣大傷，東方的君士坦丁堡既要面對匈人，又要維持皇帝在基督教世界保護者的形象，一旦被當作軟弱可欺，邊境的小摩擦就會被放大成全面戰爭。最終，狄奧多西二世選擇撕毀延續多年的和約，開戰。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The innermost was religious, and the causation ran in both directions: under Yazdegerd I some Christians attacked Zoroastrian temples in Sasanian territory, and the court answered with a persecution of Christians; after Yazdegerd I was murdered, his successor Bahram V continued that persecution, and it killed even James Intercisus, a councillor of the court who had converted to Zoroastrianism and then back again. Large numbers of Christians fled into Roman territory, where Atticus, bishop of Constantinople, took them in and reported it to the emperor, and Theodosius II, under the influence of his sister Pulcheria, was increasingly ready to see himself as the protector of Christians. The second layer was economic and juridical friction: the Sasanians had employed Roman gold-diggers and refused to send them back, and they had seized the property of Roman merchants; when the Persian ambassadors reached the court of Constantinople to demand the return of the fugitives, they were in effect denying the Roman right of sanctuary. The third layer was the succession and the frontier: Yazdegerd I died by violence in 420, Bahram V took the throne out of the court struggle, and the centre of Sasanian power leaned for a time towards Persia and Armenia in the south-east, leaving the position in Armenia and Persarmenia unsettled, with both Rome and the Sasanian court anxious to profit from it. The fourth layer was the general state of the empire: the plunder of Rome in 410 had left the west exhausted, while the court at Constantinople had to face the Huns and at the same time uphold the emperor's image as protector of the Christian world; once it was thought soft, a small border friction could swell into a general war. In the end Theodosius II chose to break a peace that had held for years and to go to war.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，在紙面上是回到戰前，在實際上留下三道痕跡。第一是條約形式的突破：422年的和約由軍務總監赫利奧代表羅馬談成，內容只有三項——恢復戰前狀態、雙方互不接受對方陣營的阿拉伯逃兵、並在各自領土上保障宗教自由。最後一項被不少史家視為東羅馬與薩珊之間最早的雙向寬教條款，因為它第一次把宗教寬容寫成雙方對等義務，而不是羅馬單方面的要求；此後數百年的兩國往來，幾乎每一份和約都重複這一段措辭。第二是戰略後果：為了東線作戰而准許東哥特人定居色雷斯，雖然解了多瑙河下游的急，卻也等於把一支數萬人的武裝同盟者放進帝國腹心；匈人王魯加在433年戰死於弗里吉杜斯河畔，東哥特人的勢力也隨之被削弱，這段因422年戰爭而起的安排，其代價要到半個世紀後才完全顯形。第三是教會與信仰的問題：狄奧多西奧波利斯被圍三十日而羅馬沒有解圍，讓東方教會記住了羅馬的鞭長莫及；而薩珊境內基督徒的處境在條約保障下暫時改善，流亡到羅馬境內的教社群體又壯大了東方的教會實力。此外，421年這場戰爭是西羅馬覆亡後東羅馬第一次大規模主動出兵的戰役，軍事成果雖小，卻向薩珊證明東線並非無力反擊——這個判斷，後來被用到更不利的方向上。
impactEn: The result of this war was, on paper, a return to the position before the war; in practice it left three marks. The first was a break in treaty form: the peace of 422 was negotiated for Rome by the magister officiorum Helio, and it contained only three clauses, a restoration of the pre-war situation, mutual refusal of the Arab defectors of the other side, and a mutual guarantee of religious liberty in each party's territory. That last clause is regarded by many historians as the earliest reciprocal clause of religious tolerance between the Eastern Roman Empire and the Sasanians, since it for the first time made toleration a duty binding on both parties rather than a Roman demand alone; for the centuries of contact that followed, almost every treaty repeated that formula. The second was strategic: to fight in the east the court had allowed the Ostrogoths to settle in Thrace, and while this answered the emergency on the lower Danube it also planted a body of tens of thousands of armed allies in the belly of the empire; the Hunnic king Ruga was killed at the Frigidus in 433 and the Ostrogothic strength was correspondingly broken, so that the arrangement born of the war of 422 only revealed its full price half a century later. The third concerned the churches: the fact that Theodosiopolis stood besieged for thirty days without Roman relief taught the eastern churches the limits of Roman reach; and the condition of Christians in Sasanian territory improved for the time under the treaty, while the exiled communities inside the Roman empire strengthened the church's position in the east. In addition, the war of 421 was the first large Roman offensive in the east since the fall of the West; its military results were small, but it demonstrated to the Sasanians that the eastern front was not incapable of striking back, and that judgement was later used to worse effect.
result: 把結果分開看：戰術層面，羅馬小有斬獲——阿爾達布爾奇襲阿爾扎內尼得手，納爾塞斯在交鋒中失利退走，羅軍在美索不達米亞搶先攔截了薩珊的反擊計畫，隨後把尼西比斯圍了起來；但薩珊沒有崩潰，國王沒有被俘，尼西比斯也沒有淪陷，這座城又守了六十多年，直到489年才落入波斯人之手。戰略層面，薩珊用北方匈人的進攻與南方阿拉伯盟友的騷擾把羅馬拖成兩面作戰，狄奧多西二世在422年召回阿爾達布爾，羅軍退出亞美尼亞與波斯亞美尼亞，收回前線，這是決定性的轉折點。外交層面，雙方在422年簽訂和約，條文恢復戰前狀態：亞美尼亞歸屬照舊，尼西比斯照舊屬羅馬，沒有割地，沒有賠款條款，只有互不收留對方逃兵與互保宗教自由。歷史學家至今對此役的評價不一，德克（Michael J. Decker）稱之為羅馬的勝利，多數史家則視為平手。真正被解決的問題只有一個：雙方都需要一個可以退回去的台階；而真正沒有被解決的問題——亞美尼亞的歸屬、邊境緩衝地、貿易與礦工的爭執——在和約生效不到兩年後就重新開打，424年與428年再度兵戎相見。
resultEn: Taken in parts, the outcome was as follows. Tactically the Romans had a modest success: Ardabur's raid into Arzanene succeeded, Narses was worsted in the engagement and withdrew, the Roman army intercepted the Sasanian plan of striking at Mesopotamia, and the siege of Nisibis was then pressed; but the Sasanian state did not collapse, the king was not captured, and Nisibis did not fall, the city holding out for another sixty-odd years until it was taken by the Persians in 489. Strategically, the Sasanians used the Hunnic advance in the north and their Arab allies in the south to pull Rome into a war on two fronts, and Theodosius II recalled Ardabur in 422; the Roman army withdrew from Armenia and Persarmenia and pulled back to the line, and that was the decisive turning point. Diplomatically, the two sides concluded a treaty in 422 whose text restored the pre-war situation: Armenia kept the status it had, Nisibis stayed Roman, there was no cession of territory and no indemnity clause, only mutual refusal of defectors and mutual guarantee of religious liberty. Historians still differ over the verdict; Michael J. Decker calls it a Roman victory, while most treat it as a stalemate. Only one problem was actually solved, namely that both sides needed a staircase to retreat down; what was not solved were the fate of Armenia, the buffer zone on the frontier, the disputes over trade and over the gold-diggers, and those reopened in arms less than two years after the treaty took effect, with war again in 424 and again in 428.
